intro: Eagle's Fist centers on a cryptic letter discovered inside a toolbox at a misty, high-altitude vantage point. The note reveals a solitary sentry watching over a weathered barricade out of allegiance to the Old Kingdoms and the Eagle and Fist. Though the campfire was recently stoked, the watcher departed in haste.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: "From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.
My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."

clips.title: Completion
paras: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
